decisions.reason: As the flagship new product line, presented on its own page and close to the core offer, the anamnesis app sits at the centre of the firm's digital practice strategy, and a growing firm has the slack to keep developing it even while its results remain uncertain.

The continuing education institute builds on the firm's existing training content and practitioner relationships, costs little to maintain, and supports customer loyalty, so in a growing firm without a performance shortfall it gives no trigger for problemistic search.

The remote screen sharing support tool is a low-cost addition to the firm's customer support that makes service more efficient, so there is no aspiration gap that would justify releasing its resources.
